entries.gave: Read invoicer as the accounting colleague meets it: the invoicer command, its help, refusals and printed invoice, and the package it rests on; its 70 tests pass.
Read N1, N2 and N3 of the code best practice, with their reasons and practices.

Answered N1 in good; N2 in more, as render and tax_of leave unsaid whether the rate is a fraction or a percent and what currency takes; N3 in more, as render currency and the default quantity of Line answer no case.
Each condition of the group, N1, N2 and N3, is answered in answers-0.json; ending with done.
